The problem statement says "reverse the case of all characters," which most naturally means swapping lower to upper and upper to lower for each character individually.  
The biggest ambiguity is whether "reverse the case" is about reversing the string order first (question 2) or just swapping case (question 1).  
Question 1 is the most critical because if the intended meaning is actually reversing the string order and then swapping case, the implementation would be completely different.  
The other questions (non-alphabetic handling, empty string, Unicode, in-place) are secondary or already implied by the function signature (returns a new string).  

ANSWER: 1
